necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness consistent with a history of atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome. Given the concurrent diagnosis of mitral valve insufficiency, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events and assess the efficacy of current rate control management. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial code CO-197.
